levels.name: Tiny Task
levels.guidance: Answer directly; do not add tools unless a real external action is explicitly requested.

levels.name: Small Project
levels.guidance: Start natively and add a tool only for a specific file, design, hosting, or collaboration need.

levels.name: Medium Project
levels.default_decision: Decide from external-file and service needs
levels.guidance: Recommend a minimal tool stack when it materially improves format handling, access, or verification.

levels.name: Complex Project
levels.default_decision: Strongly Recommended or Required for Best Result
levels.guidance: Sequence tools deliberately, explain dependencies, and avoid adding integrations that do not serve a concrete stage.

levels.name: Sensitive / High-risk Project
levels.guidance: State permissions, likely failures, a reversible plan, and confirmation points before any write action.
